name: quickchat
description: Build a customer support AI Agent from your website, try it with a real customer question, and put it live on your site, WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, Instagram, Slack or email. Review its conversations, CSAT and handoffs, triage what needs a human, and improve its knowledge, settings and AI Actions without leaving Claude. Sign in to Quickchat, or create a free account, when you first connect.
